title: PR7434 generated governance and evidence refresh environment impact closure

phases.objective: Bind generated governance evidence and control-plane registration changes to the canonical environment-impact policy without deploying, activating, mutating providers, or changing database authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Evaluate the exact PR head against the canonical deployment and environment authority policies.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Environment impact is declared for staging and production, cross-environment review is explicit, staging certification remains required, and all mutation/activation boundaries remain denied.
steps: Classify exact base-to-head changes against the canonical environment path classes.
Read back deployment, domain, runtime invariant, database authority, readiness, and staging gateway policies.
Verify the declaration binds both affected environments and requires live staging certification.
Verify production mutation, database mutation, provider mutation, credential payload reads, and production activation remain forbidden.
Bind the result to the exact evaluated HEAD SHA.
assertions: The environment impact declaration source of truth is the canonical deployment branch policy.
Both staging and production are explicitly declared and cross-environment review is true.
Live staging certification remains required and is not silently waived.
No migrations, grants, database mutations, provider mutations, credential payload reads, or production activation are introduced.
